ideas.title: Minnesota DHS Whistleblower Allegations
ideas.description: Investigate allegations of a 'smear campaign' against a Minnesota DHS whistleblower who reported fraud concerns to the state.
ideas.angle: The specific investigative angle would be to uncover the truth behind the whistleblower allegations and potential fraud within Minnesota DHS.
questions: What are the allegations against Minnesota DHS?
What actions have been taken against the whistleblower?
ideas.insight: The whistleblower allegations against Minnesota DHS raise concerns about potential fraud and mismanagement within the department. Investigating these allegations could uncover a larger pattern of corruption and abuse of power.

ideas.title: Child Care Funding Freeze
ideas.description: Investigate the implications of the $10B child care funding freeze and the halt by a judge allowing funds to flow to 5 states.
ideas.angle: The specific investigative angle would be to examine the management and oversight of these funds, as well as potential issues with fraud and mismanagement.
questions: What are the implications of the child care funding freeze?
How will the halt by a judge affect the funds?
ideas.insight: The child care funding freeze and subsequent halt by a judge raises concerns about the management and oversight of these funds. Investigating these issues could uncover potential problems with fraud and mismanagement.
